rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for saying that someone is unemployed.

example.english: The economy is bad now, and many people are unemployed.
example.traditional: 而家經濟唔好，好多人失業。
example.jyutping: ji4 gaa1 ging1 zai3 m4 hou2 hou2 do1 jan4 sat1 jip6

rows.note: Use this colloquial phrase when stressing that someone currently has no job or work available.

example.english: I’m unemployed these days, so I can only stay home every day.
example.traditional: 我呢排冇工開，唯有日日留喺屋企。
example.jyutping: ngo5 nei1 paai4 mou5 gung1 hoi1 wai4 jau5 jat6 jat6 lau4 hai2 uk1 kei2
